clauses.title: Scope – Requirements of
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements of plywood for structural purposes, such as stressed skin panels, plywood web beams, sheathing, silos, rail and ship containers.

clauses.title: Timber –The species of
clauses.text: 2.1 Timber -The species of timber recommended for use  shall be from the species mentioned in Appendix A of the standard.

clauses.title: Adhesive
clauses.text: 2.2 Adhesive — Shall conform to BWP type specified in   IS  848 : 1974*.

clauses.title: Plywood – Shall conform
clauses.text: 3. Plywood - Shall conform to BMP grade in accordance with  IS  303 : 1989 +.

clauses.title: Treatment – Shall be
clauses.text: 4. Treatment - Shall be given preservative treatment with fixed type of preservatives as per IS 5539 :1969 ++.
